title: Nigeria Specialised Institutions (Monotechnics)
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for current Nigerian institutions in the NBTE Specialised Institutions (Monotechnics) category.
methodology: SoftData reconciled the complete 98-entry Specialised Institutions (Monotechnics) section of the NBTE 25th Edition 2025 directory before generating the dataset. Names and locations were normalized to current canonical forms and state_id values were mapped to ng-states. Colleges of education, general schools, remedial institutions and other wrong-category entries were excluded and documented. The public contract intentionally contains no specialisation, website or logo fields.
source_hierarchy: official federal or state government publications
reputable secondary sources for discovery only

sources.title: 25th Edition 2025 Directory of Accredited Programmes
sources.purpose: Primary roster boundary for NBTE Specialised Institutions (Monotechnics).
missing_or_incomplete_fields: state_id is not a source field
the section includes some colleges and schools requiring category reconciliation

sources.title: Approved Institutions
sources.purpose: Confirm the official category name and separation from polytechnics, colleges and IEIs.

update_frequency: Review on each new NBTE directory or material regulatory roster update.
inclusion_rules: Current Nigerian institution placed by NBTE in Specialised Institutions (Monotechnics).
One record per current legal institution or independently approved campus.
Every state_id resolves to ng-states and every record has country_code NG.
exclusion_rules: Universities, polytechnics, colleges of education, agriculture, health, nursing, IEIs, VEIs, technical colleges, general schools, remedial institutions, closed institutions and approval-withdrawn institutions.
transitions_and_former_names: Potential renames, category movements and duplicate identities are preserved in the reconciliation manifest; no unresolved identity is imported.
known_limitations: The NBTE section is not active-only and does not normalize state_id.
The directory does not provide a reliable public specialisation field for every institution.
Approval and naming can change between directory editions.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. NBTE source publications retain their own rights. This pass adds only the static dataset foundation; websites, logos and API routes are deferred.
